Two new sub-queries against a public service already used elsewhere in this repo (packages/adapters/src/federal/fema-nfhl.ts queries the same host by point): layer 28 (Flood Hazard Zones) by POLYGON intersects for real acreage-of-intersection (never a whole-parcel flag), layer 3 (FIRM Panels) for the actual citable panel number + effective date. Neither layer-3 query nor any polygon-vs-polygon intersection exists anywhere in this codebase today -- both new capabilities, not duplicated derivations.
item_18_floodplain_acreage_firm_panel.finding_not_a_bug: femaNfhlAdapter (packages/adapters, not touched) already requests DFIRM_ID and already returns the raw ArcGIS features array on its payload, so DFIRM_ID was reachable without any adapter change -- but DFIRM_ID alone is only the 6-char county-level FIRM database id ('48021C'), never a citable panel; the real citation (FIRM_PAN, EFF_DATE) lives only on layer 3, queried by nobody in this repo before now. Verified live 2026-09-07: layer 28 returns DFIRM_ID '48021C' for both Bastrop test parcels; layer 3 resolves the same point to FIRM_PAN '48021C0355F', EFF_DATE 2023-05-09, PANEL_TYP 'Countywide, Panel Printed'.
item_18_floodplain_acreage_firm_panel.acreage_reconciliation_finding: Live-verified 2026-09-07: this resolver's own shoelace-on-GIS-ring acreage (0.093 and 0.045 acres for 52726/52727 respectively, hand-verified independently outside the resolver) disagrees with Bastrop CAD's CALC_ACRE field, which reports the IDENTICAL 0.064 for both units despite their visibly different footprints. Reads as CALC_ACRE carrying the parent platted lot's acreage forward onto both child condo-unit rows rather than a per-unit figure -- a CAD-roll data-quality finding, reported per DEV_PROCESS 1.4 rather than silently reconciled by substituting the CAD field for the parcel's actual measured geometry, which is what item 18 asks for.
item_18_floodplain_acreage_firm_panel.live_verified_result: Both 48021:52726 and 48021:52727: present, sfhaAcres=0 (two Zone X hits: 'AREA OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD' and '0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD' -- neither SFHA), firmPanel present (48021C0355F, eff. 2023-05-09). A real, cited, non-fabricated zero -- not an absence, not a whole-parcel flag.
